in_marathi.name: Ruturaj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ruturaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rutu means season and Raja means king. This name signifies a ruler of the season or a king who brings about a change in the season.

in_bengali.name: Ruturaj

in_bengali.long_meaning: Ruturaj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Rutu means season and Raja means king. This name signifies a ruler of the season or a king who brings about a change in the season.
